definitions.pooled_error: Norm of paired 2D difference. Mean and RMS pooled by reported endpoint/action-sample n; RMS is sqrt(sum(n*rms^2)/sum(n)). This reconstructs exact pooled moments up to JSON float rounding; no global quantile is inferred from per-stream quantiles.
definitions.position_percent: 100*positionRMS/30commoncounts, using the stated flexible aggregate tracking scale, not a universal per-tick acceptance bound.
definitions.velocity_percent: Each stream reports100*velocity-errorRMS/max(0.01count/ms, reference RMS vector speed). The reported aggregate is sqrt(sum(n*stream_percent^2)/sum(n)); it preserves each stream denominator and is not a pooled-speed relative percentage.
definitions.total_variation: Movement-selector probabilities only: 0.5*sum over16heads of absolute probability difference per decision. Mean/RMS pooled by decisioncount. Event hazard or brake-frequency TV is not present in these files.
definitions.events: Exact signature(at_ms,previous_mode,new_mode,brake_head). Every movement signature(at_ms,mode,movement_head) is also compared, including discarded diagnostic proposals. Event duration/coefficients are not included in the categorical signature; numerical physical output differences are reported separately.
definitions.behavior: Behavior comparisons are paired on the same validation streams. Duration-weighted means over mixed static/tracking/saved-path cases are descriptive of this roster and are not the historical full56 tracking score. First within10/30 and first moving use the harness definitions, not all restart reaction times.
definitions.identical_state: All640ms physical inputs at each reference decision are identical; implementations retain private hybrid state and seeded choices. Position difference is cumulative within each32ms committed action, not a full free-running trajectory difference.

validation_limits: These four files do not establish real-time deadlines, CPU-contention tails, startup latency or slower-machine results; separate timing/deployment evidence is required.
Native identical-state file has no movement-probabilityTV or neural-layer coefficient errors; those must come from separate numerical probes.
Closed-loop probabilities/events are collected withdiagnostics; native production-pruning parity independently proves exact output equality across this same roster.

Only three fixed saved full56 target paths are replayed. Earlier target history is not supplied by the publicAPI; these are new supported-input comparisons, not an exact reproduction or rerun of all historical full56/static/stress/transition panels.
Synthetic and reused development inputs are engineering qualification, not fresh human-equivalence evidence or evidence of behavior on untested hardware.
This summary does not infer calibrated population distributions or statistical confidence intervals from the small fixed-seed roster.
